{"content":"# Root Cause Analysis — gh-1630

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: The fa browser extension ships remotely-hosted code (jsdelivr CDN
imports for the panel's on-device engines and the offscreen runtimes' wasm),
which is a hard Chrome Web Store policy violation (Blue Argon: remote-hosted
code), and its privacy policy omits mandatory sections, so the resubmission
was rejected again with a second, longer rejection letter.

**Root cause** (three independent layers, all shipping in the package):

1. **AC1 — remote code in the panel bundle**
   `flutter_app/lib/sandbox/web_interpreters_web.dart` hardcodes
   `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/...` constants for quickjs/pyodide/sql.js and
   `flutter_app/web/inline_script_[456].js` import WebLLM /
   transformers.js / LiteRT-LM from jsdelivr `+esm`. The extension build
   (`scripts/build_browser_ext.sh --with-app`) bundles the SAME web build
   into `panel/app/`, so the shipped `main.dart.js` and `index.html` carry
   and execute remote URLs. Reachability is irrelevant for CWS: presence
   alone is rejected. (Additionally the pre-fix ondevice_stub degraded the
   on-device engines to a CSP failure — the engines were disabled rather
   than vendored.)
2. **AC1 — remote code in the offscreen run_script runtimes**
   `scripts/vendor_interpreters.sh` (v1) fetched quickjs/pyodide/sql.js
   from unpinned floating URLs (incl. bare `/npm/pkg/+esm` re-resolving
   upstream), wrote a stale `manifest.lock` (wrong names/scope/URLs), never
   re-verified an existing tree (a truncated download shipped silently),
   and never covered the panel's on-device engines at all.
3. **AC5/AC6 — store metadata regressions**
   `browser_ext/manifest.json` declared five permissions with zero call
   sites (`contentSettings`, `downloads`, `fontSettings`, `identity`,
   `desktopCapture` — Purple Potassium) and shipped a CSP without
   `'wasm-unsafe-eval'` (the vendored wasm engines cannot boot).
   `site/privacy.html` missed mandatory sections (Retention, Security,
   Children, Changes, Sharing, Storage-Handling-Collect wording) in EN/RU
   (Purple Nickel: omission of any section is not allowed).

**Impact**: Store resubmission rejected on four grounds (remote code,
unused permissions, incomplete privacy policy, and — after the first fix
attempt — still-unfetched trust signals). Every user download also executed
third-party CDN code inside the extension origin, and the offscreen pyodide
runner silently fell back to a remote `indexURL` default when the local
base was wrong.

**Fix approach** (REG-1: every rejected ground mechanically closed and
CI-enforced):

- **Lock-pinned vendoring** — `browser_ext/vendor.lock.json` pins all six
  engines (quickjs, pyodide, sqljs, webllm, transformers, litert), every
  artifact with sha256 + version-pinned URLs.
  `scripts/fetch_vendor_assets.sh` fetches, verifies, rewrites the three
  remote constants inside the vendored bundles onto the package-local dirs,
  and `--verify-only` re-verifies an existing tree (the packaging build
  calls it every run — no silent truncation).
- **No remote code in the extension builds (I3/I4)** — new
  `flutter_app/lib/sandbox/web_interpreters_urls.dart`: `--dart-define=
  FA_HOST=extension` (already passed by the build script) selects
  package-relative `../../vendor/interpreters/...` paths at COMPILE time;
  the CDN constants become dead code and are tree-shaken out of the
  compiled bundle (empirically verified: `flutter build web
  --dart-define=FA_HOST=extension` emits zero jsdelivr markers into
  main.dart.js). The pyodide runner now passes an EXPLICIT indexURL in both
  builds (kills the silent remote-default fallback).
- **Panel staging (I1/AC2)** — `scripts/stage_extension_panel.py` replaces
  the three CDN `inline_script_[456]` tags with `vendor_loader_*.js`
  modules importing the on-device engines from `vendor/<engine>/<version>/`
  — the engines WORK in the extension now (previous stub disabled them);
  idempotent, lock-driven, fails loud.
- **Manifest (AC5)** — the five dead permissions removed
  (`downloads_*` curated tools removed with `downloads`; `identity` was
  never called; `desktopCapture`/`contentSettings`/`fontSettings` were
  bridge-registry names only); CSP is `'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'`
  (wasm-unsafe-eval is required by pyodide/onnxruntime/quickjs and is the
  Google-recommended way to keep eval working WITHOUT `unsafe-eval`).
- **Privacy policy (AC6)** — `site/privacy.html` + `PRIVACY.md` rewritten:
  nine mandatory sections (`data-sec` anchored) in EN and RU, storing
  4.2.4/4.3-a "user can request deletion" sentence + `privacy@fa1.dev`
  contact, store listing links the live URL.
- **Mechanical REG-1 (AC7)** — `scripts/check_cws_compliance.py` (AC1
  source scan / AC5 manifest / AC6 privacy / AC3 lock) runs on every PR
  touching browser_ext/ in `.github/workflows/browser-ext.yml`; the
  packaging guard `scripts/ext_package_guard.py check` additionally scans
  EVERY byte of the built zip for remote-code markers (jsdelivr/unpkg/
  cdnjs/https://cdn.) and re-asserts the manifest invariants on the
  packaged copy — red blocks the artifact, not just the sources.

**Previous attempt**: the first resubmission fixed only the listing copy
and the privacy URL — none of the four technical grounds; this fix removes
the grounds themselves and adds the CI gates that keep them closed.
","path":"outputs/rca.md"}

{"content":"# Root Cause Analysis — gh-1630

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: The fa browser extension ships remotely-hosted code (jsdelivr CDN
imports for the panel's on-device engines and the offscreen runtimes' wasm),
which is a hard Chrome Web Store policy violation (Blue Argon: remote-hosted
code), and its privacy policy omits mandatory sections, so the resubmission
was rejected again with a second, longer rejection letter.

**Root cause** (three independent layers, all shipping in the package):

1. **AC1 — remote code in the panel bundle**
   `flutter_app/lib/sandbox/web_interpreters_web.dart` hardcodes
   `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/...` constants for quickjs/pyodide/sql.js and
   `flutter_app/web/inline_script_[456].js` import WebLLM /
   transformers.js / LiteRT-LM from jsdelivr `+esm`. The extension build
   (`scripts/build_browser_ext.sh --with-app`) bundles the SAME web build
   into `panel/app/`, so the shipped `main.dart.js` and `index.html` carry
   and execute remote URLs. Reachability is irrelevant for CWS: presence
   alone is rejected. (Additionally the pre-fix ondevice_stub degraded the
   on-device engines to a CSP failure — the engines were disabled rather
   than vendored.)
2. **AC1 — remote code in the offscreen run_script runtimes**
   `scripts/vendor_interpreters.sh` (v1) fetched quickjs/pyodide/sql.js
   from unpinned floating URLs (incl. bare `/npm/pkg/+esm` re-resolving
   upstream), wrote a stale `manifest.lock` (wrong names/scope/URLs), never
   re-verified an existing tree (a truncated download shipped silently),
   and never covered the panel's on-device engines at all.
3. **AC5/AC6 — store metadata regressions**
   `browser_ext/manifest.json` declared five permissions with zero call
   sites (`contentSettings`, `downloads`, `fontSettings`, `identity`,
   `desktopCapture` — Purple Potassium) and shipped a CSP without
   `'wasm-unsafe-eval'` (the vendored wasm engines cannot boot).
   `site/privacy.html` missed mandatory sections (Retention, Security,
   Children, Changes, Sharing, Storage-Handling-Collect wording) in EN/RU
   (Purple Nickel: omission of any section is not allowed).

**Impact**: Store resubmission rejected on four grounds (remote code,
unused permissions, incomplete privacy policy, and — after the first fix
attempt — still-unfetched trust signals). Every user download also executed
third-party CDN code inside the extension origin, and the offscreen pyodide
runner silently fell back to a remote `indexURL` default when the local
base was wrong.

**Fix approach** (REG-1: every rejected ground mechanically closed and
CI-enforced):

- **Lock-pinned vendoring** — `browser_ext/vendor.lock.json` pins all six
  engines (quickjs, pyodide, sqljs, webllm, transformers, litert), every
  artifact with sha256 + version-pinned URLs.
  `scripts/fetch_vendor_assets.sh` fetches, verifies, rewrites the three
  remote constants inside the vendored bundles onto the package-local dirs,
  and `--verify-only` re-verifies an existing tree (the packaging build
  calls it every run — no silent truncation).
- **No remote code in the extension builds (I3/I4)** — new
  `flutter_app/lib/sandbox/web_interpreters_urls.dart`: `--dart-define=
  FA_HOST=extension` (already passed by the build script) selects
  package-relative `../../vendor/interpreters/...` paths at COMPILE time;
  the CDN constants become dead code and are tree-shaken out of the
  compiled bundle (empirically verified: `flutter build web
  --dart-define=FA_HOST=extension` emits zero jsdelivr markers into
  main.dart.js). The pyodide runner now passes an EXPLICIT indexURL in both
  builds (kills the silent remote-default fallback).
- **Panel staging (I1/AC2)** — `scripts/stage_extension_panel.py` replaces
  the three CDN `inline_script_[456]` tags with `vendor_loader_*.js`
  modules importing the on-device engines from `vendor/<engine>/<version>/`
  — the engines WORK in the extension now (previous stub disabled them);
  idempotent, lock-driven, fails loud.
- **Manifest (AC5)** — the five dead permissions removed
  (`downloads_*` curated tools removed with `downloads`; `identity` was
  never called; `desktopCapture`/`contentSettings`/`fontSettings` were
  bridge-registry names only); CSP is `'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'`
  (wasm-unsafe-eval is required by pyodide/onnxruntime/quickjs and is the
  Google-recommended way to keep eval working WITHOUT `unsafe-eval`).
- **Privacy policy (AC6)** — `site/privacy.html` + `PRIVACY.md` rewritten:
  nine mandatory sections (`data-sec` anchored) in EN and RU, storing
  4.2.4/4.3-a "user can request deletion" sentence + `privacy@fa1.dev`
  contact, store listing links the live URL.
- **Mechanical REG-1 (AC7)** — `scripts/check_cws_compliance.py` (AC1
  source scan / AC5 manifest / AC6 privacy / AC3 lock) runs on every PR
  touching browser_ext/ in `.github/workflows/browser-ext.yml`; the
  packaging guard `scripts/ext_package_guard.py check` additionally scans
  EVERY byte of the built zip for remote-code markers (jsdelivr/unpkg/
  cdnjs/https://cdn.) and re-asserts the manifest invariants on the
  packaged copy — red blocks the artifact, not just the sources.

**Previous attempt**: the first resubmission fixed only the listing copy
and the privacy URL — none of the four technical grounds; this fix removes
the grounds themselves and adds the CI gates that keep them closed.
","path":"outputs/rca.md"}

{"content":"# Root Cause Analysis — gh-1630

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: The fa browser extension ships remotely-hosted code (jsdelivr CDN
imports for the panel's on-device engines and the offscreen runtimes' wasm),
which is a hard Chrome Web Store policy violation (Blue Argon: remote-hosted
code), and its privacy policy omits mandatory sections, so the resubmission
was rejected again with a second, longer rejection letter.

**Root cause** (three independent layers, all shipping in the package):

1. **AC1 — remote code in the panel bundle**
   `flutter_app/lib/sandbox/web_interpreters_web.dart` hardcodes
   `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/...` constants for quickjs/pyodide/sql.js and
   `flutter_app/web/inline_script_[456].js` import WebLLM /
   transformers.js / LiteRT-LM from jsdelivr `+esm`. The extension build
   (`scripts/build_browser_ext.sh --with-app`) bundles the SAME web build
   into `panel/app/`, so the shipped `main.dart.js` and `index.html` carry
   and execute remote URLs. Reachability is irrelevant for CWS: presence
   alone is rejected. (Additionally the pre-fix ondevice_stub degraded the
   on-device engines to a CSP failure — the engines were disabled rather
   than vendored.)
2. **AC1 — remote code in the offscreen run_script runtimes**
   `scripts/vendor_interpreters.sh` (v1) fetched quickjs/pyodide/sql.js
   from unpinned floating URLs (incl. bare `/npm/pkg/+esm` re-resolving
   upstream), wrote a stale `manifest.lock` (wrong names/scope/URLs), never
   re-verified an existing tree (a truncated download shipped silently),
   and never covered the panel's on-device engines at all.
3. **AC5/AC6 — store metadata regressions**
   `browser_ext/manifest.json` declared five permissions with zero call
   sites (`contentSettings`, `downloads`, `fontSettings`, `identity`,
   `desktopCapture` — Purple Potassium) and shipped a CSP without
   `'wasm-unsafe-eval'` (the vendored wasm engines cannot boot).
   `site/privacy.html` missed mandatory sections (Retention, Security,
   Children, Changes, Sharing, Storage-Handling-Collect wording) in EN/RU
   (Purple Nickel: omission of any section is not allowed).

**Impact**: Store resubmission rejected on four grounds (remote code,
unused permissions, incomplete privacy policy, and — after the first fix
attempt — still-unfetched trust signals). Every user download also executed
third-party CDN code inside the extension origin, and the offscreen pyodide
runner silently fell back to a remote `indexURL` default when the local
base was wrong.

**Fix approach** (REG-1: every rejected ground mechanically closed and
CI-enforced):

- **Lock-pinned vendoring** — `browser_ext/vendor.lock.json` pins all six
  engines (quickjs, pyodide, sqljs, webllm, transformers, litert), every
  artifact with sha256 + version-pinned URLs.
  `scripts/fetch_vendor_assets.sh` fetches, verifies, rewrites the three
  remote constants inside the vendored bundles onto the package-local dirs,
  and `--verify-only` re-verifies an existing tree (the packaging build
  calls it every run — no silent truncation).
- **No remote code in the extension builds (I3/I4)** — new
  `flutter_app/lib/sandbox/web_interpreters_urls.dart`: `--dart-define=
  FA_HOST=extension` (already passed by the build script) selects
  package-relative `../../vendor/interpreters/...` paths at COMPILE time;
  the CDN constants become dead code and are tree-shaken out of the
  compiled bundle (empirically verified: `flutter build web
  --dart-define=FA_HOST=extension` emits zero jsdelivr markers into
  main.dart.js). The pyodide runner now passes an EXPLICIT indexURL in both
  builds (kills the silent remote-default fallback).
- **Panel staging (I1/AC2)** — `scripts/stage_extension_panel.py` replaces
  the three CDN `inline_script_[456]` tags with `vendor_loader_*.js`
  modules importing the on-device engines from `vendor/<engine>/<version>/`
  — the engines WORK in the extension now (previous stub disabled them);
  idempotent, lock-driven, fails loud.
- **Manifest (AC5)** — the five dead permissions removed
  (`downloads_*` curated tools removed with `downloads`; `identity` was
  never called; `desktopCapture`/`contentSettings`/`fontSettings` were
  bridge-registry names only); CSP is `'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'`
  (wasm-unsafe-eval is required by pyodide/onnxruntime/quickjs and is the
  Google-recommended way to keep eval working WITHOUT `unsafe-eval`).
- **Privacy policy (AC6)** — `site/privacy.html` + `PRIVACY.md` rewritten:
  nine mandatory sections (`data-sec` anchored) in EN and RU, storing
  4.2.4/4.3-a "user can request deletion" sentence + `privacy@fa1.dev`
  contact, store listing links the live URL.
- **Mechanical REG-1 (AC7)** — `scripts/check_cws_compliance.py` (AC1
  source scan / AC5 manifest / AC6 privacy / AC3 lock) runs on every PR
  touching browser_ext/ in `.github/workflows/browser-ext.yml`; the
  packaging guard `scripts/ext_package_guard.py check` additionally scans
  EVERY byte of the built zip for remote-code markers (jsdelivr/unpkg/
  cdnjs/https://cdn.) and re-asserts the manifest invariants on the
  packaged copy — red blocks the artifact, not just the sources.

**Previous attempt**: the first resubmission fixed only the listing copy
and the privacy URL — none of the four technical grounds; this fix removes
the grounds themselves and adds the CI gates that keep them closed.

{"content":"# Root Cause Analysis — gh-1630

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: The fa browser extension ships remotely-hosted code (jsdelivr CDN
imports for the panel's on-device engines and the offscreen runtimes' wasm),
which is a hard Chrome Web Store policy violation (Blue Argon: remote-hosted
code), and its privacy policy omits mandatory sections, so the resubmission
was rejected again with a second, longer rejection letter.

**Root cause** (three independent layers, all shipping in the package):

1. **AC1 — remote code in the panel bundle**
   `flutter_app/lib/sandbox/web_interpreters_web.dart` hardcodes
   `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/...` constants for quickjs/pyodide/sql.js and
   `flutter_app/web/inline_script_[456].js` import WebLLM /
   transformers.js / LiteRT-LM from jsdelivr `+esm`. The extension build
   (`scripts/build_browser_ext.sh --with-app`) bundles the SAME web build
   into `panel/app/`, so the shipped `main.dart.js` and `index.html` carry
   and execute remote URLs. Reachability is irrelevant for CWS: presence
   alone is rejected. (Additionally the pre-fix ondevice_stub degraded the
   on-device engines to a CSP failure — the engines were disabled rather
   than vendored.)
2. **AC1 — remote code in the offscreen run_script runtimes**
   `scripts/vendor_interpreters.sh` (v1) fetched quickjs/pyodide/sql.js
   from unpinned floating URLs (incl. bare `/npm/pkg/+esm` re-resolving
   upstream), wrote a stale `manifest.lock` (wrong names/scope/URLs), never
   re-verified an existing tree (a truncated download shipped silently),
   and never covered the panel's on-device engines at all.
3. **AC5/AC6 — store metadata regressions**
   `browser_ext/manifest.json` declared five permissions with zero call
   sites (`contentSettings`, `downloads`, `fontSettings`, `identity`,
   `desktopCapture` — Purple Potassium) and shipped a CSP without
   `'wasm-unsafe-eval'` (the vendored wasm engines cannot boot).
   `site/privacy.html` missed mandatory sections (Retention, Security,
   Children, Changes, Sharing, Storage-Handling-Collect wording) in EN/RU
   (Purple Nickel: omission of any section is not allowed).

**Impact**: Store resubmission rejected on four grounds (remote code,
unused permissions, incomplete privacy policy, and — after the first fix
attempt — still-unfetched trust signals). Every user download also executed
third-party CDN code inside the extension origin, and the offscreen pyodide
runner silently fell back to a remote `indexURL` default when the local
base was wrong.

**Fix approach** (REG-1: every rejected ground mechanically closed and
CI-enforced):

- **Lock-pinned vendoring** — `browser_ext/vendor.lock.json` pins all six
  engines (quickjs, pyodide, sqljs, webllm, transformers, litert), every
  artifact with sha256 + version-pinned URLs.
  `scripts/fetch_vendor_assets.sh` fetches, verifies, rewrites the three
  remote constants inside the vendored bundles onto the package-local dirs,
  and `--verify-only` re-verifies an existing tree (the packaging build
  calls it every run — no silent truncation).
- **No remote code in the extension builds (I3/I4)** — new
  `flutter_app/lib/sandbox/web_interpreters_urls.dart`: `--dart-define=
  FA_HOST=extension` (already passed by the build script) selects
  package-relative `../../vendor/interpreters/...` paths at COMPILE time;
  the CDN constants become dead code and are tree-shaken out of the
  compiled bundle (empirically verified: `flutter build web
  --dart-define=FA_HOST=extension` emits zero jsdelivr markers into
  main.dart.js). The pyodide runner now passes an EXPLICIT indexURL in both
  builds (kills the silent remote-default fallback).
- **Panel staging (I1/AC2)** — `scripts/stage_extension_panel.py` replaces
  the three CDN `inline_script_[456]` tags with `vendor_loader_*.js`
  modules importing the on-device engines from `vendor/<engine>/<version>/`
  — the engines WORK in the extension now (previous stub disabled them);
  idempotent, lock-driven, fails loud.
- **Manifest (AC5)** — the five dead permissions removed
  (`downloads_*` curated tools removed with `downloads`; `identity` was
  never called; `desktopCapture`/`contentSettings`/`fontSettings` were
  bridge-registry names only); CSP is `'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'`
  (wasm-unsafe-eval is required by pyodide/onnxruntime/quickjs and is the
  Google-recommended way to keep eval working WITHOUT `unsafe-eval`).
- **Privacy policy (AC6)** — `site/privacy.html` + `PRIVACY.md` rewritten:
  nine mandatory sections (`data-sec` anchored) in EN and RU, storing
  4.2.4/4.3-a "user can request deletion" sentence + `privacy@fa1.dev`
  contact, store listing links the live URL.
- **Mechanical REG-1 (AC7)** — `scripts/check_cws_compliance.py` (AC1
  source scan / AC5 manifest / AC6 privacy / AC3 lock) runs on every PR
  touching browser_ext/ in `.github/workflows/browser-ext.yml`; the
  packaging guard `scripts/ext_package_guard.py check` additionally scans
  EVERY byte of the built zip for remote-code markers (jsdelivr/unpkg/
  cdnjs/https://cdn.) and re-asserts the manifest invariants on the
  packaged copy — red blocks the artifact, not just the sources.

**Previous attempt**: the first resubmission fixed only the listing copy
and the privacy URL — none of the four technical grounds; this fix removes
the grounds themselves and adds the CI gates that keep them closed.

30 memories:
project: (note) Unified cross-project messaging root is ~/.fah/messages/, replacing per-project ~/.fah/sessions/<cwd-slug>/messages/.
project: (note) All communicating agents must run the same updated fa binary version for the unified messaging root to work.
project: (note) flutter_agent root contains install_local.sh that builds and installs fa to ~/.local/bin/fa with ad-hoc macOS code signing.
project: (note) The locally built bundle binary lives at flutter_agent/fa-local/bundle/bin/fah.
project: (note) Cheaper models may fail native tool calling and emit tool-like text instead of actual tool calls.
project: (note) JoinGonka gateway (gate.joingonka.ai) with model moonshotai/Kimi-K2.6 supports native tool calling (finish_reason: tool_calls) and works reliably even on large contexts (~100k tokens).
project: (note) The mojibake issue with Cyrillic text (e.g., `ÐÐ»Ð¸...`) is caused by UTF-8 bytes being interpreted as Latin-1 in the display layer, not by the session file itself which is valid UTF-8.
project: (note) Added a `_compactionFailureHint` helper in lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart that catches usage-limit/rate-limit errors and prints a human-readable message pointing to `roles.smol` in ~/.fah/config.yaml.
project: (note) In fa TUI, slash-commands (like /settings) execute immediately even while the agent is streaming, but plain text messages get queued and sent after the current run completes.
project: (note) TUI mouse mode is now auto-detected at startup (TuiMouseMode.auto): it captures the mouse for 500ms and keeps capture only if a wheel event arrives; can be forced with FA_TUI_MOUSE=1 (capture) or FA_TUI_MOUSE=0 (native selection), and toggled at runtime with the `/mouse` slash-command.
project: (note) The TUI history limit was raised from 200 to 2000 lines, and then the hard limit was removed entirely so the full session (loaded from JSONL) is available for scrolling.
project: (note) Dynamic lazy-loading of session history on scroll is not feasible because the markdown formatter is stateful (code fences, tables) — rendering a window requires replaying from the start, so the full formatted buffer is kept in memory instead.
project: (note) Shift+drag is the preferred way to select text in the terminal even when the TUI has captured the mouse for wheel scrolling.
project: (note) CLI media slots vision and transcription must be resolved from models.slots config, not just CLI flags; keys resolved via saved custom providers by matching baseUrl (name-scoped keyName).
project: (note) MiniMax-M3 vision model at api.minimax.io/v1 uses key FA_KEY_API_MINIMAX_IO_MINIMAX (name-scoped custom provider key), not endpoint-scoped FA_KEY_API_MINIMAX_IO.
project: (note) Image/audio/music/video generation tools are NOT in CLI — they live only in Flutter app (media_tools.dart) via MediaGateway, which depends on Flutter-bound MediaModelsStore.
project: (note) AgentTool API changed: uses `parameters` (not `params`), `execute` (not `handler`), `tier` = `ApprovalTier` (not `ToolTier`).
project: (note) Edits to code may be reverted/commented out by others; always verify changes are present and compile before proceeding.
project: (note) Attached images are sent inline to the main chat model (Path 1), NOT through the vision slot — they become part of history and are replayed every turn
project: (note) Vision slot (media_models) is used only by tools like read_video/inspect_image that send frames to a separate endpoint and return only text (Path 2)
project: (note) Google adapter now retries once on exact 400 'Unable to process input image' error by replacing inlineData images with text placeholder '(image omitted: the model backend could not decode it)' — allows agent to gracefully handle corrupt images
project: (note) PNG→JPEG conversion in the Google adapter runs on every history replay — CPU cost on large screenshots; cache or app-side conversion flagged as future improvement
project: (note) Chat provider's 'vision' setting (e.g., Ollama/Gemma) does NOT control image reading when images are attached inline — it only controls the separate vision slot
project: (note) TUI markdown rendering in fa CLI measures terminal cell width using grapheme clusters (tui_text_width.dart) instead of UTF-16 length to prevent emoji/CJK row desync.
project: (note) TUI mouse capture is enabled by default for scrolling, with FA_TUI_MOUSE=0 providing an opt-out.
project: (note) CRAP score gate in this repository requires functions without PTY tests to maintain cyclomatic complexity CC <= 3 to satisfy max CRAP 12.
project: (note) The agent approval system includes an 'unattended' mode for fully autonomous runs that auto-approves all actions including critical bash patterns, whereas 'yolo' mode retains prompts for critical bash commands.
project: (note) Third-party skills discovery in flutter_agent defaults to granted (opt-out), and desktop apps resolve user-level skill roots (~/.copilot/skills, ~/.agents/skills, ~/.claude) via desktopHomeDir().
project: (note) The local environment has multiple GitHub accounts; pushing and dispatching workflows on IstiN/flutter_agent_harness requires switching gh auth to 'IstiN'.
project: (note) On macOS, fa stores sessions in ~/Library/Group Containers/group.dev.fa1.shared/fa/sessions/ to share history with Flutter macOS app.

{"content":"# Root Cause Analysis — gh-1630

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: The fa browser extension ships remotely-hosted code (jsdelivr CDN
imports for the panel's on-device engines and the offscreen runtimes' wasm),
which is a hard Chrome Web Store policy violation (Blue Argon: remote-hosted
code), and its privacy policy omits mandatory sections, so the resubmission
was rejected again with a second, longer rejection letter.

**Root cause** (three independent layers, all shipping in the package):

1. **AC1 — remote code in the panel bundle**
   `flutter_app/lib/sandbox/web_interpreters_web.dart` hardcodes
   `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/...` constants for quickjs/pyodide/sql.js and
   `flutter_app/web/inline_script_[456].js` import WebLLM /
   transformers.js / LiteRT-LM from jsdelivr `+esm`. The extension build
   (`scripts/build_browser_ext.sh --with-app`) bundles the SAME web build
   into `panel/app/`, so the shipped `main.dart.js` and `index.html` carry
   and execute remote URLs. Reachability is irrelevant for CWS: presence
   alone is rejected. (Additionally the pre-fix ondevice_stub degraded the
   on-device engines to a CSP failure — the engines were disabled rather
   than vendored.)
2. **AC1 — remote code in the offscreen run_script runtimes**
   `scripts/vendor_interpreters.sh` (v1) fetched quickjs/pyodide/sql.js
   from unpinned floating URLs (incl. bare `/npm/pkg/+esm` re-resolving
   upstream), wrote a stale `manifest.lock` (wrong names/scope/URLs), never
   re-verified an existing tree (a truncated download shipped silently),
   and never covered the panel's on-device engines at all.
3. **AC5/AC6 — store metadata regressions**
   `browser_ext/manifest.json` declared five permissions with zero call
   sites (`contentSettings`, `downloads`, `fontSettings`, `identity`,
   `desktopCapture` — Purple Potassium) and shipped a CSP without
   `'wasm-unsafe-eval'` (the vendored wasm engines cannot boot).
   `site/privacy.html` missed mandatory sections (Retention, Security,
   Children, Changes, Sharing, Storage-Handling-Collect wording) in EN/RU
   (Purple Nickel: omission of any section is not allowed).

**Impact**: Store resubmission rejected on four grounds (remote code,
unused permissions, incomplete privacy policy, and — after the first fix
attempt — still-unfetched trust signals). Every user download also executed
third-party CDN code inside the extension origin, and the offscreen pyodide
runner silently fell back to a remote `indexURL` default when the local
base was wrong.

**Fix approach** (REG-1: every rejected ground mechanically closed and
CI-enforced):

- **Lock-pinned vendoring** — `browser_ext/vendor.lock.json` pins all six
  engines (quickjs, pyodide, sqljs, webllm, transformers, litert), every
  artifact with sha256 + version-pinned URLs.
  `scripts/fetch_vendor_assets.sh` fetches, verifies, rewrites the three
  remote constants inside the vendored bundles onto the package-local dirs,
  and `--verify-only` re-verifies an existing tree (the packaging build
  calls it every run — no silent truncation).
- **No remote code in the extension builds (I3/I4)** — new
  `flutter_app/lib/sandbox/web_interpreters_urls.dart`: `--dart-define=
  FA_HOST=extension` (already passed by the build script) selects
  package-relative `../../vendor/interpreters/...` paths at COMPILE time;
  the CDN constants become dead code and are tree-shaken out of the
  compiled bundle (empirically verified: `flutter build web
  --dart-define=FA_HOST=extension` emits zero jsdelivr markers into
  main.dart.js). The pyodide runner now passes an EXPLICIT indexURL in both
  builds (kills the silent remote-default fallback).
- **Panel staging (I1/AC2)** — `scripts/stage_extension_panel.py` replaces
  the three CDN `inline_script_[456]` tags with `vendor_loader_*.js`
  modules importing the on-device engines from `vendor/<engine>/<version>/`
  — the engines WORK in the extension now (previous stub disabled them);
  idempotent, lock-driven, fails loud.
- **Manifest (AC5)** — the five dead permissions removed
  (`downloads_*` curated tools removed with `downloads`; `identity` was
  never called; `desktopCapture`/`contentSettings`/`fontSettings` were
  bridge-registry names only); CSP is `'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'`
  (wasm-unsafe-eval is required by pyodide/onnxruntime/quickjs and is the
  Google-recommended way to keep eval working WITHOUT `unsafe-eval`).
- **Privacy policy (AC6)** — `site/privacy.html` + `PRIVACY.md` rewritten:
  nine mandatory sections (`data-sec` anchored) in EN and RU, storing
  4.2.4/4.3-a "user can request deletion" sentence + `privacy@fa1.dev`
  contact, store listing links the live URL.
- **Mechanical REG-1 (AC7)** — `scripts/check_cws_compliance.py` (AC1
  source scan / AC5 manifest / AC6 privacy / AC3 lock) runs on every PR
  touching browser_ext/ in `.github/workflows/browser-ext.yml`; the
  packaging guard `scripts/ext_package_guard.py check` additionally scans
  EVERY byte of the built zip for remote-code markers (jsdelivr/unpkg/
  cdnjs/https://cdn.) and re-asserts the manifest invariants on the
  packaged copy — red blocks the artifact, not just the sources.

**Previous attempt**: the first resubmission fixed only the listing copy
and the privacy URL — none of the four technical grounds; this fix removes
the grounds themselves and adds the CI gates that keep them closed.

{"content":"# Root Cause Analysis — gh-1630

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: The fa browser extension ships remotely-hosted code (jsdelivr CDN
imports for the panel's on-device engines and the offscreen runtimes' wasm),
which is a hard Chrome Web Store policy violation (Blue Argon: remote-hosted
code), and its privacy policy omits mandatory sections, so the resubmission
was rejected again with a second, longer rejection letter.

**Root cause** (three independent layers, all shipping in the package):

1. **AC1 — remote code in the panel bundle**
   `flutter_app/lib/sandbox/web_interpreters_web.dart` hardcodes
   `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/...` constants for quickjs/pyodide/sql.js and
   `flutter_app/web/inline_script_[456].js` import WebLLM /
   transformers.js / LiteRT-LM from jsdelivr `+esm`. The extension build
   (`scripts/build_browser_ext.sh --with-app`) bundles the SAME web build
   into `panel/app/`, so the shipped `main.dart.js` and `index.html` carry
   and execute remote URLs. Reachability is irrelevant for CWS: presence
   alone is rejected. (Additionally the pre-fix ondevice_stub degraded the
   on-device engines to a CSP failure — the engines were disabled rather
   than vendored.)
2. **AC1 — remote code in the offscreen run_script runtimes**
   `scripts/vendor_interpreters.sh` (v1) fetched quickjs/pyodide/sql.js
   from unpinned floating URLs (incl. bare `/npm/pkg/+esm` re-resolving
   upstream), wrote a stale `manifest.lock` (wrong names/scope/URLs), never
   re-verified an existing tree (a truncated download shipped silently),
   and never covered the panel's on-device engines at all.
3. **AC5/AC6 — store metadata regressions**
   `browser_ext/manifest.json` declared five permissions with zero call
   sites (`contentSettings`, `downloads`, `fontSettings`, `identity`,
   `desktopCapture` — Purple Potassium) and shipped a CSP without
   `'wasm-unsafe-eval'` (the vendored wasm engines cannot boot).
   `site/privacy.html` missed mandatory sections (Retention, Security,
   Children, Changes, Sharing, Storage-Handling-Collect wording) in EN/RU
   (Purple Nickel: omission of any section is not allowed).

**Impact**: Store resubmission rejected on four grounds (remote code,
unused permissions, incomplete privacy policy, and — after the first fix
attempt — still-unfetched trust signals). Every user download also executed
third-party CDN code inside the extension origin, and the offscreen pyodide
runner silently fell back to a remote `indexURL` default when the local
base was wrong.

**Fix approach** (REG-1: every rejected ground mechanically closed and
CI-enforced):

- **Lock-pinned vendoring** — `browser_ext/vendor.lock.json` pins all six
  engines (quickjs, pyodide, sqljs, webllm, transformers, litert), every
  artifact with sha256 + version-pinned URLs.
  `scripts/fetch_vendor_assets.sh` fetches, verifies, rewrites the three
  remote constants inside the vendored bundles onto the package-local dirs,
  and `--verify-only` re-verifies an existing tree (the packaging build
  calls it every run — no silent truncation).
- **No remote code in the extension builds (I3/I4)** — new
  `flutter_app/lib/sandbox/web_interpreters_urls.dart`: `--dart-define=
  FA_HOST=extension` (already passed by the build script) selects

30 memories:
project: (note) Unified cross-project messaging root is ~/.fah/messages/, replacing per-project ~/.fah/sessions/<cwd-slug>/messages/.
project: (note) All communicating agents must run the same updated fa binary version for the unified messaging root to work.
project: (note) flutter_agent root contains install_local.sh that builds and installs fa to ~/.local/bin/fa with ad-hoc macOS code signing.
project: (note) The locally built bundle binary lives at flutter_agent/fa-local/bundle/bin/fah.
project: (note) Cheaper models may fail native tool calling and emit tool-like text instead of actual tool calls.
project: (note) JoinGonka gateway (gate.joingonka.ai) with model moonshotai/Kimi-K2.6 supports native tool calling (finish_reason: tool_calls) and works reliably even on large contexts (~100k tokens).
project: (note) The mojibake issue with Cyrillic text (e.g., `ÐÐ»Ð¸...`) is caused by UTF-8 bytes being interpreted as Latin-1 in the display layer, not by the session file itself which is valid UTF-8.
project: (note) Added a `_compactionFailureHint` helper in lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart that catches usage-limit/rate-limit errors and prints a human-readable message pointing to `roles.smol` in ~/.fah/config.yaml.
project: (note) In fa TUI, slash-commands (like /settings) execute immediately even while the agent is streaming, but plain text messages get queued and sent after the current run completes.
project: (note) TUI mouse mode is now auto-detected at startup (TuiMouseMode.auto): it captures the mouse for 500ms and keeps capture only if a wheel event arrives; can be forced with FA_TUI_MOUSE=1 (capture) or FA_TUI_MOUSE=0 (native selection), and toggled at runtime with the `/mouse` slash-command.
project: (note) The TUI history limit was raised from 200 to 2000 lines, and then the hard limit was removed entirely so the full session (loaded from JSONL) is available for scrolling.
project: (note) Dynamic lazy-loading of session history on scroll is not feasible because the markdown formatter is stateful (code fences, tables) — rendering a window requires replaying from the start, so the full formatted buffer is kept in memory instead.
project: (note) Shift+drag is the preferred way to select text in the terminal even when the TUI has captured the mouse for wheel scrolling.
project: (note) CLI media slots vision and transcription must be resolved from models.slots config, not just CLI flags; keys resolved via saved custom providers by matching baseUrl (name-scoped keyName).
project: (note) MiniMax-M3 vision model at api.minimax.io/v1 uses key FA_KEY_API_MINIMAX_IO_MINIMAX (name-scoped custom provider key), not endpoint-scoped FA_KEY_API_MINIMAX_IO.
project: (note) Image/audio/music/video generation tools are NOT in CLI — they live only in Flutter app (media_tools.dart) via MediaGateway, which depends on Flutter-bound MediaModelsStore.
project: (note) AgentTool API changed: uses `parameters` (not `params`), `execute` (not `handler`), `tier` = `ApprovalTier` (not `ToolTier`).
project: (note) Edits to code may be reverted/commented out by others; always verify changes are present and compile before proceeding.
project: (note) Attached images are sent inline to the main chat model (Path 1), NOT through the vision slot — they become part of history and are replayed every turn
project: (note) Vision slot (media_models) is used only by tools like read_video/inspect_image that send frames to a separate endpoint and return only text (Path 2)
project: (note) Google adapter now retries once on exact 400 'Unable to process input image' error by replacing inlineData images with text placeholder '(image omitted: the model backend could not decode it)' — allows agent to gracefully handle corrupt images
project: (note) PNG→JPEG conversion in the Google adapter runs on every history replay — CPU cost on large screenshots; cache or app-side conversion flagged as future improvement
project: (note) Chat provider's 'vision' setting (e.g., Ollama/Gemma) does NOT control image reading when images are attached inline — it only controls the separate vision slot
project: (note) TUI markdown rendering in fa CLI measures terminal cell width using grapheme clusters (tui_text_width.dart) instead of UTF-16 length to prevent emoji/CJK row desync.

{"content":"# Root Cause Analysis — gh-1630

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: The fa browser extension ships remotely-hosted code (jsdelivr CDN
imports for the panel's on-device engines and the offscreen runtimes' wasm),
which is a hard Chrome Web Store policy violation (Blue Argon: remote-hosted
code), and its privacy policy omits mandatory sections, so the resubmission
was rejected again with a second, longer rejection letter.

**Root cause** (three independent layers, all shipping in the package):

1. **AC1 — remote code in the panel bundle**
   `flutter_app/lib/sandbox/web_interpreters_web.dart` hardcodes
   `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/...` constants for quickjs/pyodide/sql.js and
   `flutter_app/web/inline_script_[456].js` import WebLLM /
   transformers.js / LiteRT-LM from jsdelivr `+esm`. The extension build
   (`scripts/build_browser_ext.sh --with-app`) bundles the SAME web build
   into `panel/app/`, so the shipped `main.dart.js` and `index.html` carry
   and execute remote URLs. Reachability is irrelevant for CWS: presence
   alone is rejected. (Additionally the pre-fix ondevice_stub degraded the
   on-device engines to a CSP failure — the engines were disabled rather
   than vendored.)
2. **AC1 — remote code in the offscreen run_script runtimes**
   `scripts/vendor_interpreters.sh` (v1) fetched quickjs/pyodide/sql.js
   from unpinned floating URLs (incl. bare `/npm/pkg/+esm` re-resolving
   upstream), wrote a stale `manifest.lock` (wrong names/scope/URLs), never
   re-verified an existing tree (a truncated download shipped silently),
   and never covered the panel's on-device engines at all.
3. **AC5/AC6 — store metadata regressions**
   `browser_ext/manifest.json` declared five permissions with zero call
   sites (`contentSettings`, `downloads`, `fontSettings`, `identity`,
   `desktopCapture` — Purple Potassium) and shipped a CSP without
   `'wasm-unsafe-eval'` (the vendored wasm engines cannot boot).
   `site/privacy.html` missed mandatory sections (Retention, Security,
   Children, Changes, Sharing, Storage-Handling-Collect wording) in EN/RU
   (Purple Nickel: omission of any section is not allowed).

**Impact**: Store resubmission rejected on four grounds (remote code,
unused permissions, incomplete privacy policy, and — after the first fix
attempt — still-unfetched trust signals). Every user download also executed
third-party CDN code inside the extension origin, and the offscreen pyodide
runner silently fell back to a remote `indexURL` default when the local
base was wrong.

**Fix approach** (REG-1: every rejected ground mechanically closed and
CI-enforced):

- **Lock-pinned vendoring** — `browser_ext/vendor.lock.json` pins all six
  engines (quickjs, pyodide, sqljs, webllm, transformers, litert), every
  artifact with sha256 + version-pinned URLs.
  `scripts/fetch_vendor_assets.sh` fetches, verifies, rewrites the three
  remote constants inside the vendored bundles onto the package-local dirs,
  and `--verify-only` re-verifies an existing tree (the packaging build
  calls it every run — no silent truncation).
- **No remote code in the extension builds (I3/I4)** — new
  `flutter_app/lib/sandbox/web_interpreters_urls.dart`: `--dart-define=
  FA_HOST=extension` (already passed by the build script) selects
  package-relative `../../vendor/interpreters/...` paths at COMPILE time;
  the CDN constants become dead code and are tree-shaken out of the
  compiled bundle (empirically verified: `flutter build web
  --dart-define=FA_HOST=extension` emits zero jsdelivr markers into
  main.dart.js). The pyodide runner now passes an EXPLICIT indexURL in both
  builds (kills the silent remote-default fallback).
- **Panel staging (I1/AC2)** — `scripts/stage_extension_panel.py` replaces
  the three CDN `inline_script_[456]` tags with `vendor_loader_*.js`
  modules importing the on-device engines from `vendor/<engine>/<version>/`
  — the engines WORK in the extension now (previous stub disabled them);
  idempotent, lock-driven, fails loud.
- **Manifest (AC5)** — the five dead permissions removed
  (`downloads_*` curated tools removed with `downloads`; `identity` was
  never called; `desktopCapture`/`contentSettings`/`fontSettings` were
  bridge-registry names only); CSP is `'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'`
  (wasm-unsafe-eval is required by pyodide/onnxruntime/quickjs and is the
  Google-recommended way to keep eval working WITHOUT `unsafe-eval`).
- **Privacy policy (AC6)** — `site/privacy.html` + `PRIVACY.md` rewritten:
  nine mandatory sections (`data-sec` anchored) in EN and RU, storing
  4.2.4/4.3-a "user can request deletion" sentence + `privacy@fa1.dev`
  contact, store listing links the live URL.
- **Mechanical REG-1 (AC7)** — `scripts/check_cws_compliance.py` (AC1
  source scan / AC5 manifest / AC6 privacy / AC3 lock) runs on every PR
  touching browser_ext/ in `.github/workflows/browser-ext.yml`; the
  packaging guard `scripts/ext_package_guard.py check` additionally scans
  EVERY byte of the built zip for remote-code markers (jsdelivr/unpkg/
  cdnjs/https://cdn.) and re-asserts the manifest invariants on the
  packaged copy — red blocks the artifact, not just the sources.

**Previous attempt**: the first resubmission fixed only the listing copy
and the privacy URL — none of the four technical grounds; this fix removes
the grounds themselves and adds the CI gates that keep them closed.

project: (note) Unified cross-project messaging root is ~/.fah/messages/, replacing per-project ~/.fah/sessions/<cwd-slug>/messages/.
project: (note) All communicating agents must run the same updated fa binary version for the unified messaging root to work.
project: (note) flutter_agent root contains install_local.sh that builds and installs fa to ~/.local/bin/fa with ad-hoc macOS code signing.
project: (note) The locally built bundle binary lives at flutter_agent/fa-local/bundle/bin/fah.
project: (note) Cheaper models may fail native tool calling and emit tool-like text instead of actual tool calls.
project: (note) JoinGonka gateway (gate.joingonka.ai) with model moonshotai/Kimi-K2.6 supports native tool calling (finish_reason: tool_calls) and works reliably even on large contexts (~100k tokens).
project: (note) The mojibake issue with Cyrillic text (e.g., `ÐÐ»Ð¸...`) is caused by UTF-8 bytes being interpreted as Latin-1 in the display layer, not by the session file itself which is valid UTF-8.
project: (note) Added a `_compactionFailureHint` helper in lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart that catches usage-limit/rate-limit errors and prints a human-readable message pointing to `roles.smol` in ~/.fah/config.yaml.
project: (note) In fa TUI, slash-commands (like /settings) execute immediately even while the agent is streaming, but plain text messages get queued and sent after the current run completes.
project: (note) TUI mouse mode is now auto-detected at startup (TuiMouseMode.auto): it captures the mouse for 500ms and keeps capture only if a wheel event arrives; can be forced with FA_TUI_MOUSE=1 (capture) or FA_TUI_MOUSE=0 (native selection), and toggled at runtime with the `/mouse` slash-command.
project: (note) The TUI history limit was raised from 200 to 2000 lines, and then the hard limit was removed entirely so the full session (loaded from JSONL) is available for scrolling.
project: (note) Dynamic lazy-loading of session history on scroll is not feasible because the markdown formatter is stateful (code fences, tables) — rendering a window requires replaying from the start, so the full formatted buffer is kept in memory instead.
project: (note) Shift+drag is the preferred way to select text in the terminal even when the TUI has captured the mouse for wheel scrolling.
project: (note) CLI media slots vision and transcription must be resolved from models.slots config, not just CLI flags; keys resolved via saved custom providers by matching baseUrl (name-scoped keyName).
project: (note) MiniMax-M3 vision model at api.minimax.io/v1 uses key FA_KEY_API_MINIMAX_IO_MINIMAX (name-scoped custom provider key), not endpoint-scoped FA_KEY_API_MINIMAX_IO.
project: (note) Image/audio/music/video generation tools are NOT in CLI — they live only in Flutter app (media_tools.dart) via MediaGateway, which depends on Flutter-bound MediaModelsStore.
project: (note) AgentTool API changed: uses `parameters` (not `params`), `execute` (not `handler`), `tier` = `ApprovalTier` (not `ToolTier`).
project: (note) Edits to code may be reverted/commented out by others; always verify changes are present and compile before proceeding.
project: (note) Attached images are sent inline to the main chat model (Path 1), NOT through the vision slot — they become part of history and are replayed every turn
project: (note) Vision slot (media_models) is used only by tools like read_video/inspect_image that send frames to a separate endpoint and return only text (Path 2)
project: (note) Google adapter now retries once on exact 400 'Unable to process input image' error by replacing inlineData images with text placeholder '(image omitted: the model backend could not decode it)' — allows agent to gracefully handle corrupt images
project: (note) PNG→JPEG conversion in the Google adapter runs on every history replay — CPU cost on large screenshots; cache or app-side conversion flagged as future improvement
project: (note) Chat provider's 'vision' setting (e.g., Ollama/Gemma) does NOT control image reading when images are attached inline — it only controls the separate vision slot
project: (note) TUI markdown rendering in fa CLI measures terminal cell width using grapheme clusters (tui_text_width.dart) instead of UTF-16 length to prevent emoji/CJK row desync.
project: (note) TUI mouse capture is enabled by default for scrolling, with FA_TUI_MOUSE=0 providing an opt-out.
project: (note) CRAP score gate in this repository requires functions without PTY tests to maintain cyclomatic complexity CC <= 3 to satisfy max CRAP 12.
project: (note) The agent approval system includes an 'unattended' mode for fully autonomous runs that auto-approves all actions including critical bash patterns, whereas 'yolo' mode retains prompts for critical bash commands.
project: (note) Third-party skills discovery in flutter_agent defaults to granted (opt-out), and desktop apps resolve user-level skill roots (~/.copilot/skills, ~/.agents/skills, ~/.claude) via desktopHomeDir().

project: (note) Unified cross-project messaging root is ~/.fah/messages/, replacing per-project ~/.fah/sessions/<cwd-slug>/messages/.

project: (note) The locally built bundle binary lives at flutter_agent/fa-local/bundle/bin/fah.
project: (note) Cheaper models may fail native tool calling and emit tool-like text instead of actual tool calls.
project: (note) JoinGonka gateway (gate.joingonka.ai) with model moonshotai/Kimi-K2.6 supports native tool calling (finish_reason: tool_calls) and works reliably even on large contexts (~100k tokens).
project: (note) The mojibake issue with Cyrillic text (e.g., `ÐÐ»Ð¸...`) is caused by UTF-8 bytes being interpreted as Latin-1 in the display layer, not by the session file itself which is valid UTF-8.
project: (note) Added a `_compactionFailureHint` helper in lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart that catches usage-limit/rate-limit errors and prints a human-readable message pointing to `roles.smol` in ~/.fah/config.yaml.
project: (note) In fa TUI, slash-commands (like /settings) execute immediately even while the agent is streaming, but plain text messages get queued and sent after the current run completes.
project: (note) TUI mouse mode is now auto-detected at startup (TuiMouseMode.auto): it captures the mouse for 500ms and keeps capture only if a wheel event arrives; can be forced with FA_TUI_MOUSE=1 (capture) or FA_TUI_MOUSE=0 (native selection), and toggled at runtime with the `/mouse` slash-command.
project: (note) The TUI history limit was raised from 200 to 2000 lines, and then the hard limit was removed entirely so the full session (loaded from JSONL) is available for scrolling.
project: (note) Dynamic lazy-loading of session history on scroll is not feasible because the markdown formatter is stateful (code fences, tables) — rendering a window requires replaying from the start, so the full formatted buffer is kept in memory instead.
project: (note) Shift+drag is the preferred way to select text in the terminal even when the TUI has captured the mouse for wheel scrolling.
project: (note) CLI media slots vision and transcription must be resolved from models.slots config, not just CLI flags; keys resolved via saved custom providers by matching baseUrl (name-scoped keyName).
project: (note) MiniMax-M3 vision model at api.minimax.io/v1 uses key FA_KEY_API_MINIMAX_IO_MINIMAX (name-scoped custom provider key), not endpoint-scoped FA_KEY_API_MINIMAX_IO.
project: (note) Image/audio/music/video generation tools are NOT in CLI — they live only in Flutter app (media_tools.dart) via MediaGateway, which depends on Flutter-bound MediaModelsStore.
project: (note) AgentTool API changed: uses `parameters` (not `params`), `execute` (not `handler`), `tier` = `ApprovalTier` (not `ToolTier`).
project: (note) Edits to code may be reverted/commented out by others; always verify changes are present and compile before proceeding.
project: (note) Attached images are sent inline to the main chat model (Path 1), NOT through the vision slot — they become part of history and are replayed every turn
project: (note) Vision slot (media_models) is used only by tools like read_video/inspect_image that send frames to a separate endpoint and return only text (Path 2)
project: (note) Google adapter now retries once on exact 400 'Unable to process input image' error by replacing inlineData images with text placeholder '(image omitted: the model backend could not decode it)' — allows agent to gracefully handle corrupt images
project: (note) PNG→JPEG conversion in the Google adapter runs on every history replay — CPU cost on large screenshots; cache or app-side conversion flagged as future improvement
project: (note) Chat provider's 'vision' setting (e.g., Ollama/Gemma) does NOT control image reading when images are attached inline — it only controls the separate vision slot
project: (note) TUI markdown rendering in fa CLI measures terminal cell width using grapheme clusters (tui_text_width.dart) instead of UTF-16 length to prevent emoji/CJK row desync.
project: (note) TUI mouse capture is enabled by default for scrolling, with FA_TUI_MOUSE=0 providing an opt-out.

project: (note) Unified cross-project messaging root is ~/.fah/messages/, replacing per-project ~/.fah/sessions/<cwd-slug>/messages/.
project: (note) All communicating agents must run the same updated fa binary version for the unified messaging root to work.

project: (note) The locally built bundle binary lives at flutter_agent/fa-local/bundle/bin/fah.
project: (note) Cheaper models may fail native tool calling and emit tool-like text instead of actual tool calls.
project: (note) JoinGonka gateway (gate.joingonka.ai) with model moonshotai/Kimi-K2.6 supports native tool calling (finish_reason: tool_calls) and works reliably even on large contexts (~100k tokens).
project: (note) The mojibake issue with Cyrillic text (e.g., `ÐÐ»Ð¸...`) is caused by UTF-8 bytes being interpreted as Latin-1 in the display layer, not by the session file itself which is valid UTF-8.
project: (note) Added a `_compactionFailureHint` helper in lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart that catches usage-limit/rate-limit errors and prints a human-readable message pointing to `roles.smol` in ~/.fah/config.yaml.
project: (note) In fa TUI, slash-commands (like /settings) execute immediately even while the agent is streaming, but plain text messages get queued and sent after the current run completes.
project: (note) TUI mouse mode is now auto-detected at startup (TuiMouseMode.auto): it captures the mouse for 500ms and keeps capture only if a wheel event arrives; can be forced with FA_TUI_MOUSE=1 (capture) or FA_TUI_MOUSE=0 (native selection), and toggled at runtime with the `/mouse` slash-command.
project: (note) The TUI history limit was raised from 200 to 2000 lines, and then the hard limit was removed entirely so the full session (loaded from JSONL) is available for scrolling.
project: (note) Dynamic lazy-loading of session history on scroll is not feasible because the markdown formatter is stateful (code fences, tables) — rendering a window requires replaying from the start, so the full formatted buffer is kept in memory instead.
project: (note) Shift+drag is the preferred way to select text in the terminal even when the TUI has captured the mouse for wheel scrolling.
project: (note) CLI media slots vision and transcription must be resolved from models.slots config, not just CLI flags; keys resolved via saved custom providers by matching baseUrl (name-scoped keyName).
project: (note) MiniMax-M3 vision model at api.minimax.io/v1 uses key FA_KEY_API_MINIMAX_IO_MINIMAX (name-scoped custom provider key), not endpoint-scoped FA_KEY_API_MINIMAX_IO.
project: (note) Image/audio/music/video generation tools are NOT in CLI — they live only in Flutter app (media_tools.dart) via MediaGateway, which depends on Flutter-bound MediaModelsStore.
project: (note) AgentTool API changed: uses `parameters` (not `params`), `execute` (not `handler`), `tier` = `ApprovalTier` (not `ToolTier`).
project: (note) Edits to code may be reverted/commented out by others; always verify changes are present and compile before proceeding.
project: (note) Attached images are sent inline to the main chat model (Path 1), NOT through the vision slot — they become part of history and are replayed every turn
project: (note) Vision slot (media_models) is used only by tools like read_video/inspect_image that send frames to a separate endpoint and return only text (Path 2)
project: (note) Google adapter now retries once on exact 400 'Unable to process input image' error by replacing inlineData images with text placeholder '(image omitted: the model backend could not decode it)' — allows agent to gracefully handle corrupt images
project: (note) PNG→JPEG conversion in the Google adapter runs on every history replay — CPU cost on large screenshots; cache or app-side conversion flagged as future improvement
project: (note) Chat provider's 'vision' setting (e.g., Ollama/Gemma) does NOT control image reading when images are attached inline — it only controls the separate vision slot
project: (note) TUI markdown rendering in fa CLI measures terminal cell width using grapheme clusters (tui_text_width.dart) instead of UTF-16 length to prevent emoji/CJK row desync.
project: (note) TUI mouse capture is enabled by default for scrolling, with FA_TUI_MOUSE=0 providing an opt-out.
project: (note) CRAP score gate in this repository requires functions without PTY tests to maintain cyclomatic complexity CC <= 3 to satisfy max CRAP 12.
project: (note) The agent approval system includes an 'unattended' mode for fully autonomous runs that auto-approves all actions including critical bash patterns, whereas 'yolo' mode retains prompts for critical bash commands.
project: (note) Third-party skills discovery in flutter_agent defaults to granted (opt-out), and desktop apps resolve user-level skill roots (~/.copilot/skills, ~/.agents/skills, ~/.claude) via desktopHomeDir().

project: (note) The TUI history limit was raised from 200 to 2000 lines, and then the hard limit was removed entirely so the full session (loaded from JSONL) is available for scrolling.
project: (note) Dynamic lazy-loading of session history on scroll is not feasible because the markdown formatter is stateful (code fences, tables) — rendering a window requires replaying from the start, so the full formatted buffer is kept in memory instead.
project: (note) Shift+drag is the preferred way to select text in the terminal even when the TUI has captured the mouse for wheel scrolling.

project: (note) Edits to code may be reverted/commented out by others; always verify changes are present and compile before proceeding.

project: (note) Unified cross-project messaging root is ~/.fah/messages/, replacing per-project ~/.fah/sessions/<cwd-slug>/messages/.

project: (note) The locally built bundle binary lives at flutter_agent/fa-local/bundle/bin/fah.
project: (note) Cheaper models may fail native tool calling and emit tool-like text instead of actual tool calls.
project: (note) JoinGonka gateway (gate.joingonka.ai) with model moonshotai/Kimi-K2.6 supports native tool calling (finish_reason: tool_calls) and works reliably even on large contexts (~100k tokens).
project: (note) The mojibake issue with Cyrillic text (e.g., `ÐÐ»Ð¸...`) is caused by UTF-8 bytes being interpreted as Latin-1 in the display layer, not by the session file itself which is valid UTF-8.
project: (note) Added a `_compactionFailureHint` helper in lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart that catches usage-limit/rate-limit errors and prints a human-readable message pointing to `roles.smol` in ~/.fah/config.yaml.
project: (note) In fa TUI, slash-commands (like /settings) execute immediately even while the agent is streaming, but plain text messages get queued and sent after the current run completes.
project: (note) TUI mouse mode is now auto-detected at startup (TuiMouseMode.auto): it captures the mouse for 500ms and keeps capture only if a wheel event arrives; can be forced with FA_TUI_MOUSE=1 (capture) or FA_TUI_MOUSE=0 (native selection), and toggled at runtime with the `/mouse` slash-command.
project: (note) The TUI history limit was raised from 200 to 2000 lines, and then the hard limit was removed entirely so the full session (loaded from JSONL) is available for scrolling.
project: (note) Dynamic lazy-loading of session history on scroll is not feasible because the markdown formatter is stateful (code fences, tables) — rendering a window requires replaying from the start, so the full formatted buffer is kept in memory instead.
project: (note) Shift+drag is the preferred way to select text in the terminal even when the TUI has captured the mouse for wheel scrolling.
project: (note) CLI media slots vision and transcription must be resolved from models.slots config, not just CLI flags; keys resolved via saved custom providers by matching baseUrl (name-scoped keyName).
project: (note) MiniMax-M3 vision model at api.minimax.io/v1 uses key FA_KEY_API_MINIMAX_IO_MINIMAX (name-scoped custom provider key), not endpoint-scoped FA_KEY_API_MINIMAX_IO.
project: (note) Image/audio/music/video generation tools are NOT in CLI — they live only in Flutter app (media_tools.dart) via MediaGateway, which depends on Flutter-bound MediaModelsStore.
project: (note) AgentTool API changed: uses `parameters` (not `params`), `execute` (not `handler`), `tier` = `ApprovalTier` (not `ToolTier`).
project: (note) Edits to code may be reverted/commented out by others; always verify changes are present and compile before proceeding.
project: (note) Attached images are sent inline to the main chat model (Path 1), NOT through the vision slot — they become part of history and are replayed every turn
project: (note) Vision slot (media_models) is used only by tools like read_video/inspect_image that send frames to a separate endpoint and return only text (Path 2)
project: (note) Google adapter now retries once on exact 400 'Unable to process input image' error by replacing inlineData images with text placeholder '(image omitted: the model backend could not decode it)' — allows agent to gracefully handle corrupt images
project: (note) PNG→JPEG conversion in the Google adapter runs on every history replay — CPU cost on large screenshots; cache or app-side conversion flagged as future improvement
project: (note) Chat provider's 'vision' setting (e.g., Ollama/Gemma) does NOT control image reading when images are attached inline — it only controls the separate vision slot
project: (note) TUI markdown rendering in fa CLI measures terminal cell width using grapheme clusters (tui_text_width.dart) instead of UTF-16 length to prevent emoji/CJK row desync.
project: (note) TUI mouse capture is enabled by default for scrolling, with FA_TUI_MOUSE=0 providing an opt-out.
project: (note) CRAP score gate in this repository requires functions without PTY tests to maintain cyclomatic complexity CC <= 3 to satisfy max CRAP 12.
project: (note) The agent approval system includes an 'unattended' mode for fully autonomous runs that auto-approves all actions including critical bash patterns, whereas 'yolo' mode retains prompts for critical bash commands.
project: (note) Third-party skills discovery in flutter_agent defaults to granted (opt-out), and desktop apps resolve user-level skill roots (~/.copilot/skills, ~/.agents/skills, ~/.claude) via desktopHomeDir().

project: (note) Unified cross-project messaging root is ~/.fah/messages/, replacing per-project ~/.fah/sessions/<cwd-slug>/messages/.

project: (note) The locally built bundle binary lives at flutter_agent/fa-local/bundle/bin/fah.
project: (note) Cheaper models may fail native tool calling and emit tool-like text instead of actual tool calls.
project: (note) JoinGonka gateway (gate.joingonka.ai) with model moonshotai/Kimi-K2.6 supports native tool calling (finish_reason: tool_calls) and works reliably even on large contexts (~100k tokens).
project: (note) The mojibake issue with Cyrillic text (e.g., `ÐÐ»Ð¸...`) is caused by UTF-8 bytes being interpreted as Latin-1 in the display layer, not by the session file itself which is valid UTF-8.
project: (note) Added a `_compactionFailureHint` helper in lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart that catches usage-limit/rate-limit errors and prints a human-readable message pointing to `roles.smol` in ~/.fah/config.yaml.
project: (note) In fa TUI, slash-commands (like /settings) execute immediately even while the agent is streaming, but plain text messages get queued and sent after the current run completes.
project: (note) TUI mouse mode is now auto-detected at startup (TuiMouseMode.auto): it captures the mouse for 500ms and keeps capture only if a wheel event arrives; can be forced with FA_TUI_MOUSE=1 (capture) or FA_TUI_MOUSE=0 (native selection), and toggled at runtime with the `/mouse` slash-command.
project: (note) The TUI history limit was raised from 200 to 2000 lines, and then the hard limit was removed entirely so the full session (loaded from JSONL) is available for scrolling.
project: (note) Dynamic lazy-loading of session history on scroll is not feasible because the markdown formatter is stateful (code fences, tables) — rendering a window requires replaying from the start, so the full formatted buffer is kept in memory instead.
project: (note) Shift+drag is the preferred way to select text in the terminal even when the TUI has captured the mouse for wheel scrolling.
project: (note) CLI media slots vision and transcription must be resolved from models.slots config, not just CLI flags; keys resolved via saved custom providers by matching baseUrl (name-scoped keyName).
project: (note) MiniMax-M3 vision model at api.minimax.io/v1 uses key FA_KEY_API_MINIMAX_IO_MINIMAX (name-scoped custom provider key), not endpoint-scoped FA_KEY_API_MINIMAX_IO.
project: (note) Image/audio/music/video generation tools are NOT in CLI — they live only in Flutter app (media_tools.dart) via MediaGateway, which depends on Flutter-bound MediaModelsStore.
project: (note) AgentTool API changed: uses `parameters` (not `params`), `execute` (not `handler`), `tier` = `ApprovalTier` (not `ToolTier`).
project: (note) Edits to code may be reverted/commented out by others; always verify changes are present and compile before proceeding.
project: (note) Attached images are sent inline to the main chat model (Path 1), NOT through the vision slot — they become part of history and are replayed every turn
project: (note) Vision slot (media_models) is used only by tools like read_video/inspect_image that send frames to a separate endpoint and return only text (Path 2)
project: (note) Google adapter now retries once on exact 400 'Unable to process input image' error by replacing inlineData images with text placeholder '(image omitted: the model backend could not decode it)' — allows agent to gracefully handle corrupt images
project: (note) PNG→JPEG conversion in the Google adapter runs on every history replay — CPU cost on large screenshots; cache or app-side conversion flagged as future improvement
project: (note) Chat provider's 'vision' setting (e.g., Ollama/Gemma) does NOT control image reading when images are attached inline — it only controls the separate vision slot
project: (note) TUI markdown rendering in fa CLI measures terminal cell width using grapheme clusters (tui_text_width.dart) instead of UTF-16 length to prevent emoji/CJK row desync.
project: (note) TUI mouse capture is enabled by default for scrolling, with FA_TUI_MOUSE=0 providing an opt-out.
project: (note) CRAP score gate in this repository requires functions without PTY tests to maintain cyclomatic complexity CC <= 3 to satisfy max CRAP 12.
project: (note) The agent approval system includes an 'unattended' mode for fully autonomous runs that auto-approves all actions including critical bash patterns, whereas 'yolo' mode retains prompts for critical bash commands.
project: (note) Third-party skills discovery in flutter_agent defaults to granted (opt-out), and desktop apps resolve user-level skill roots (~/.copilot/skills, ~/.agents/skills, ~/.claude) via desktopHomeDir().

30 memories:
project: (note) Unified cross-project messaging root is ~/.fah/messages/, replacing per-project ~/.fah/sessions/<cwd-slug>/messages/.
project: (note) All communicating agents must run the same updated fa binary version for the unified messaging root to work.
project: (note) flutter_agent root contains install_local.sh that builds and installs fa to ~/.local/bin/fa with ad-hoc macOS code signing.
project: (note) The locally built bundle binary lives at flutter_agent/fa-local/bundle/bin/fah.
project: (note) Cheaper models may fail native tool calling and emit tool-like text instead of actual tool calls.
project: (note) JoinGonka gateway (gate.joingonka.ai) with model moonshotai/Kimi-K2.6 supports native tool calling (finish_reason: tool_calls) and works reliably even on large contexts (~100k tokens).
project: (note) The mojibake issue with Cyrillic text (e.g., `ÐÐ»Ð¸...`) is caused by UTF-8 bytes being interpreted as Latin-1 in the display layer, not by the session file itself which is valid UTF-8.
project: (note) Added a `_compactionFailureHint` helper in lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart that catches usage-limit/rate-limit errors and prints a human-readable message pointing to `roles.smol` in ~/.fah/config.yaml.
project: (note) In fa TUI, slash-commands (like /settings) execute immediately even while the agent is streaming, but plain text messages get queued and sent after the current run completes.
project: (note) TUI mouse mode is now auto-detected at startup (TuiMouseMode.auto): it captures the mouse for 500ms and keeps capture only if a wheel event arrives; can be forced with FA_TUI_MOUSE=1 (capture) or FA_TUI_MOUSE=0 (native selection), and toggled at runtime with the `/mouse` slash-command.
project: (note) The TUI history limit was raised from 200 to 2000 lines, and then the hard limit was removed entirely so the full session (loaded from JSONL) is available for scrolling.
project: (note) Dynamic lazy-loading of session history on scroll is not feasible because the markdown formatter is stateful (code fences, tables) — rendering a window requires replaying from the start, so the full formatted buffer is kept in memory instead.
project: (note) Shift+drag is the preferred way to select text in the terminal even when the TUI has captured the mouse for wheel scrolling.
project: (note) CLI media slots vision and transcription must be resolved from models.slots config, not just CLI flags; keys resolved via saved custom providers by matching baseUrl (name-scoped keyName).
project: (note) MiniMax-M3 vision model at api.minimax.io/v1 uses key FA_KEY_API_MINIMAX_IO_MINIMAX (name-scoped custom provider key), not endpoint-scoped FA_KEY_API_MINIMAX_IO.
project: (note) Image/audio/music/video generation tools are NOT in CLI — they live only in Flutter app (media_tools.dart) via MediaGateway, which depends on Flutter-bound MediaModelsStore.
project: (note) AgentTool API changed: uses `parameters` (not `params`), `execute` (not `handler`), `tier` = `ApprovalTier` (not `ToolTier`).
project: (note) Edits to code may be reverted/commented out by others; always verify changes are present and compile before proceeding.
project: (note) Attached images are sent inline to the main chat model (Path 1), NOT through the vision slot — they become part of history and are replayed every turn
project: (note) Vision slot (media_models) is used only by tools like read_video/inspect_image that send frames to a separate endpoint and return only text (Path 2)
project: (note) Google adapter now retries once on exact 400 'Unable to process input image' error by replacing inlineData images with text placeholder '(image omitted: the model backend could not decode it)' — allows agent to gracefully handle corrupt images
project: (note) PNG→JPEG conversion in the Google adapter runs on every history replay — CPU cost on large screenshots; cache or app-side conversion flagged as future improvement
project: (note) Chat provider's 'vision' setting (e.g., Ollama/Gemma) does NOT control image reading when images are attached inline — it only controls the separate vision slot
project: (note) TUI markdown rendering in fa CLI measures terminal cell width using grapheme clusters (tui_text_width.dart) instead of UTF-16 length to prevent emoji/CJK row desync.
project: (note) TUI mouse capture is enabled by default for scrolling, with FA_TUI_MOUSE=0 providing an opt-out.
project: (note) CRAP score gate in this repository requires functions without PTY tests to maintain cyclomatic complexity CC <= 3 to satisfy max CRAP 12.
project: (note) The agent approval system includes an 'unattended' mode for fully autonomous runs that auto-approves all actions including critical bash patterns, whereas 'yolo' mode retains prompts for critical bash commands.
project: (note) Third-party skills discovery in flutter_agent defaults to granted (opt-out), and desktop apps resolve user-level skill roots (~/.copilot/skills, ~/.agents/skills, ~/.claude) via desktopHomeDir().
project: (note) The local environment has multiple GitHub accounts; pushing and dispatching workflows on IstiN/flutter_agent_harness requires switching gh auth to 'IstiN'.
project: (note) On macOS, fa stores sessions in ~/Library/Group Containers/group.dev.fa1.shared/fa/sessions/ to share history with Flutter macOS app.

blocks.text:
30 memories:
project: (note) Unified cross-project messaging root is ~/.fah/messages/, replacing per-project ~/.fah/sessions/<cwd-slug>/messages/.
project: (note) All communicating agents must run the same updated fa binary version for the unified messaging root to work.
project: (note) flutter_agent root contains install_local.sh that builds and installs fa to ~/.local/bin/fa with ad-hoc macOS code signing.
project: (note) The locally built bundle binary lives at flutter_agent/fa-local/bundle/bin/fah.
project: (note) Cheaper models may fail native tool calling and emit tool-like text instead of actual tool calls.
project: (note) JoinGonka gateway (gate.joingonka.ai) with model moonshotai/Kimi-K2.6 supports native tool calling (finish_reason: tool_calls) and works reliably even on large contexts (~100k tokens).
project: (note) The mojibake issue with Cyrillic text (e.g., `ÐÐ»Ð¸...`) is caused by UTF-8 bytes being interpreted as Latin-1 in the display layer, not by the session file itself which is valid UTF-8.
project: (note) Added a `_compactionFailureHint` helper in lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart that catches usage-limit/rate-limit errors and prints a human-readable message pointing to `roles.smol` in ~/.fah/config.yaml.
project: (note) In fa TUI, slash-commands (like /settings) execute immediately even while the agent is streaming, but plain text messages get queued and sent after the current run completes.
project: (note) TUI mouse mode is now auto-detected at startup (TuiMouseMode.auto): it captures the mouse for 500ms and keeps capture only if a wheel event arrives; can be forced with FA_TUI_MOUSE=1 (capture) or FA_TUI_MOUSE=0 (native selection), and toggled at runtime with the `/mouse` slash-command.
project: (note) The TUI history limit was raised from 200 to 2000 lines, and then the hard limit was removed entirely so the full session (loaded from JSONL) is available for scrolling.
project: (note) Dynamic lazy-loading of session history on scroll is not feasible because the markdown formatter is stateful (code fences, tables) — rendering a window requires replaying from the start, so the full formatted buffer is kept in memory instead.
project: (note) Shift+drag is the preferred way to select text in the terminal even when the TUI has captured the mouse for wheel scrolling.
project: (note) CLI media slots vision and transcription must be resolved from models.slots config, not just CLI flags; keys resolved via saved custom providers by matching baseUrl (name-scoped keyName).
project: (note) MiniMax-M3 vision model at api.minimax.io/v1 uses key FA_KEY_API_MINIMAX_IO_MINIMAX (name-scoped custom provider key), not endpoint-scoped FA_KEY_API_MINIMAX_IO.
project: (note) Image/audio/music/video generation tools are NOT in CLI — they live only in Flutter app (media_tools.dart) via MediaGateway, which depends on Flutter-bound MediaModelsStore.
project: (note) AgentTool API changed: uses `parameters` (not `params`), `execute` (not `handler`), `tier` = `ApprovalTier` (not `ToolTier`).
project: (note) Edits to code may be reverted/commented out by others; always verify changes are present and compile before proceeding.
project: (note) Attached images are sent inline to the main chat model (Path 1), NOT through the vision slot — they become part of history and are replayed every turn
project: (note) Vision slot (media_models) is used only by tools like read_video/inspect_image that send frames to a separate endpoint and return only text (Path 2)
project: (note) Google adapter now retries once on exact 400 'Unable to process input image' error by replacing inlineData images with text placeholder '(image omitted: the model backend could not decode it)' — allows agent to gracefully handle corrupt images
project: (note) PNG→JPEG conversion in the Google adapter runs on every history replay — CPU cost on large screenshots; cache or app-side conversion flagged as future improvement
project: (note) Chat provider's 'vision' setting (e.g., Ollama/Gemma) does NOT control image reading when images are attached inline — it only controls the separate vision slot
project: (note) TUI markdown rendering in fa CLI measures terminal cell width using grapheme clusters (tui_text_width.dart) instead of UTF-16 length to prevent emoji/CJK row desync.
